THE BATTERY — A1–A5, A7. A1 is the packet's whole promise in the owner's own image: a settlement moved to the coast KEEPS its harbour master — every pinned chosen fact unchanged (the same NPCs by id, the same institution roster, the same faction archetypes) while the derivations recompute.
